# Helper functions
```{r}
plot_pc_signature_layout <- function(data,
                                     signature_col,
                                     pc_x = "PC_1",
                                     pc_y = "PC_2",
                                     palette_option = "inferno",
                                     plot_title = NULL,
                                     point.alpha.use = 0.6,
                                     clip = F) { 
  
  xlims   <- range(data[[pc_x]], na.rm = TRUE)
  ylims   <- range(data[[pc_y]], na.rm = TRUE)
  siglims <- range(data[[signature_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (is.null(plot_title)) plot_title <- signature_col
  
  # clipping
  limits <- quantile(data[[signature_col]], probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = T)
  
  if (clip) {
    data[[signature_col]] <- pmax(limits[1], pmin(data[[signature_col]], limits[2]))
    siglims <- range(data[[signature_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  p.main <- ggplot(data,
                   aes(x = .data[[pc_x]],
                       y = .data[[pc_y]],
                       color = .data[[signature_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = palette_option, 
                          limits = limits,       
                          oob = scales::squish
                          ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ylims, expand = c(0,0)) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = pc_x, y = pc_y, color = "") + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(color = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15))
  
  p.pc1 <- ggplot(data,
                  aes(x = .data[[pc_x]],
                      y = .data[[signature_col]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = point.alpha.use,
               aes(color = timepoint)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", #loess
                se = TRUE,
                linewidth = 0.8,
                color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = siglims, expand = c(0,0)) +
    ylab("Signature score") +
    timepoints.color.scale +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson",
             cor.coef.name = "R",
             size = 5) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14)
    )
  
  return(list(main = p.main, marginal = p.pc1))
}

```



# Figure: C34809 PCA before and after denoising, by cell type (high-quality only)
```{r}
pc_x_col <- "PC_1"
pc_y_col <- "PC_2"

seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3ByPatientFinal/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS'))

patient.id.use <- "C34809"
seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (patient_id == patient.id.use) & (low.quality.by.qc == FALSE))

outliers <- c("HTAN_pHGG_6477_Reg2_snRNA_CTTAGGAAGTCTGGTT-1")

pcs <- c(1, 2)
directions <- c("Positive", "Negative")


plot.list <- list()
plot.list.supp <- list()
enrichment.results.df <- data.frame()
pc.genes.df <- data.frame()
  
for (celltype.use in c("Lymphoid", "Myeloid", "Endothelial", "Malignant cluster")) { 
  for (denoise in c(F, T)) {
    print(celltype.use)
    
    seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = (annotation.l2.w.qc == celltype.use) & (cell.id %ni% outliers))
    seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset.celltype, gene.signatures[c("postmortem.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "heat.shock.signature")])
    seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset.celltype, gene.signatures.gsea.celltype)

    seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset.celltype)
    
    if (denoise) {
      seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.subset.celltype, vars.to.regress = c("postmortem.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "heat.shock.signature"))
    } else {
      seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.subset.celltype)
    }
    
    set.seed(123)
    seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.subset.celltype, features = VariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset), approx = T, seed.use = 42, npcs = 30)
    
    celltype.signature.use <- case_when(
      celltype.use == "Lymphoid" ~ "T_CELL_DIFFERENTIATION", 
      celltype.use == "Myeloid" ~ "PHAGOCYTOSIS",
      celltype.use == "Endothelial" ~ "VASCULAR_TRANSPORT", #VASCULAR_PROCESS
      celltype.use == "Malignant cluster" ~ "EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
    
    noise.signature.use <- "CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_HEAT" # CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_STRESS
    
    seurat.obj.subset.celltype$heat.shock.signature.original <- seurat.obj.subset.celltype$heat.shock.signature
    seurat.obj.subset.celltype$postmortem.sensitive.original <- seurat.obj.subset.celltype$postmortem.sensitive
    seurat.obj.subset.celltype$postmortem.signature.original <- seurat.obj.subset.celltype$postmortem.signature
    
    plot_data <- FetchData(seurat.obj.subset.celltype, 
                           vars = c(pc_x_col, pc_y_col, "timepoint", celltype.signature.use, noise.signature.use,
                                    "heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature",
                                    "heat.shock.signature.original", "postmortem.sensitive.original", "postmortem.signature.original"))
    
    
    # denoise signatures as well
    confounders <- c("heat.shock.signature.original", "postmortem.sensitive.original", "postmortem.signature.original")
     
    for (y_var in c(noise.signature.use, celltype.signature.use, "heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature")) {
      if (denoise) {
        formula_str <- paste(y_var, "~", paste(confounders, collapse = " + "))
        model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = plot_data, na.action = na.exclude)
        plot_data[[y_var]] <- residuals(model)
      }
      
      # scale
      plot_data[[y_var]] <- as.numeric(scale(plot_data[[y_var]]))
    }
    

    
    set.seed(123)
    plot_data <- plot_data[sample(1:nrow(plot_data)), ]
    
    if (denoise) {
      plot_title <- "After denoising"
    } else {
      plot_title <- "Before denoising"
    }
    
    if (celltype.use == "Malignant cluster") {
      alpha.use <- 0.2
    } else {
      alpha.use <- 0.6
    }
    
    
   
    # ----- LEFT MAIN PCA -----
    global_xlim <- range(plot_data[[pc_x_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    global_ylim <- range(plot_data[[pc_y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    p.timepoint <- ggplot(plot_data,
                          aes(x = .data[[pc_x_col]],
                              y = .data[[pc_y_col]],
                              color = timepoint)) +
      geom_point(size = 2, alpha = alpha.use) +
      timepoints.color.scale +
      labs(color = "") +
      ggtitle(paste0(plot_title, ": ", celltype.use)) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
      ) +
      guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3))) +
      theme(
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = global_xlim, ylim = global_ylim, expand = FALSE)
    
    # ----- BIOLOGY -----
    bio <- plot_pc_signature_layout(plot_data,
                                    celltype.signature.use,
                                    point.alpha.use = alpha.use,
                                    pc_x = pc_x_col,
                                    pc_y = pc_y_col)
    
    # ----- NOISE -----
    noise <- plot_pc_signature_layout(plot_data,
                                      noise.signature.use,
                                      point.alpha.use = alpha.use,
                                      pc_x = pc_x_col,
                                      pc_y = pc_y_col)
    
    
    p <- (
      p.timepoint | noise$main | bio$main 
    ) /
    (
      plot_spacer() | noise$marginal | bio$marginal 
    ) +
      plot_layout(heights = c(4, 1))
    
    pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "denoising_improvement_visual/", "sussman2024pHGG_", patient.id.use, "_pca_by_timepoint_celltype=", celltype.use, "_denoise=", denoise, ".pdf"), width=24, height=10)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    
    plot.list[[paste0(denoise, "_", celltype.use)]] <- p
    
    
    p.postmortem.signature <- plot_pc_signature_layout(plot_data, "postmortem.signature", plot_title = "Postmortem enriched", point.alpha.use = alpha.use, clip = T)
    p.postmortem.sensitive <- plot_pc_signature_layout(plot_data, "postmortem.sensitive", plot_title = "Living enriched", point.alpha.use = alpha.use, clip = T)
    p.heat.shock <- plot_pc_signature_layout(plot_data, "heat.shock.signature", plot_title = "Hypoxia heat shock", point.alpha.use = alpha.use, clip = T)
    
    p <- (
      p.timepoint | p.postmortem.signature$main | p.postmortem.sensitive$main | p.heat.shock$main
    ) /
    (
      plot_spacer() | p.postmortem.signature$marginal | p.postmortem.sensitive$marginal | p.heat.shock$marginal
    ) +
      plot_layout(heights = c(4, 1))
    
    pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "denoising_improvement_visual/", "sussman2024pHGG_", patient.id.use, "_pca_by_timepoint_celltype=", celltype.use, "_denoise=", denoise, ".pdf"), width=32, height=10)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    
    plot.list.supp[[paste0(denoise, "_", celltype.use)]] <- p
    
    
    # loop pcs and directions and get pathway/GO enrichment per PC and direction
    for (pc in pcs) {
      for (dir in directions) {
        
        # Get all loadings for the current PC
        loadings <- Loadings(seurat.obj.subset.celltype, reduction = "pca")[, pc]
        
        # Extract genes with strict sign filtering
        if (dir == "Positive") {
          # Filter for strictly positive, then sort descending
          pos_loadings <- loadings[loadings > 0]
          genes <- sort(pos_loadings, decreasing = TRUE) %>% head(100) %>% names()
          
        } else if (dir == "Negative") {
          # Filter for strictly negative, then sort ascending (most negative first)
          neg_loadings <- loadings[loadings < 0]
          genes <- sort(neg_loadings, decreasing = FALSE) %>% head(100) %>% names()
        }
        
        genes.df <- data.frame(ggene = genes)
        genes.df$cell_type <- celltype.use
        genes.df$direction <- dir
        genes.df$pc <- pc
        genes.df$deniose <- denoise
        pc.genes.df <- rbind(pc.genes.df, genes.df)
        
        # Convert Symbols to Entrez IDs
        gene_ids <- bitr(genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
        
        # Run GO Enrichment
        ego <- enrichGO(gene          = gene_ids$ENTREZID,
                        OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        ont           = "BP", 
                        pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                        readable      = TRUE) # readable=TRUE converts Entrez back to Symbols in results
        
        ego.df <- data.frame(ego) %>% filter(FoldEnrichment > 1) %>% arrange(qvalue)
        
        if (nrow(ego.df) == 0) {
          next
        }
        
        ego.df$cell_type <- celltype.use
        ego.df$direction <- dir
        ego.df$pc <- pc
        ego.df$denoise <- denoise
        enrichment.results.df <- rbind(enrichment.results.df, ego.df)
      }
    }
  }
}

p <- wrap_plots(plot.list, ncol = 1)
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "denoising_improvement_visual/", "sussman2024pHGG_", patient.id.use, "_pca_by_timepoint_before_vs_after_denoise.pdf"), width=24, height=80)
print(p)
dev.off()

p <- wrap_plots(plot.list.supp, ncol = 1)
pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "denoising_improvement_visual/", "sussman2024pHGG_", patient.id.use, "_pca_by_timepoint_before_vs_after_denoise.pdf"), width=32, height=80)
print(p)
dev.off()

write.table(enrichment.results.df, paste0(figures.dir, "Supplemental/", "PC_enrichment_results.tsv"), row.names = F, sep = "\t", quote = F)
write.table(pc.genes.df, paste0(figures.dir, "Supplemental/", "PC_genes_denoise.tsv"), row.names = F, sep = "\t", quote = F)
```

```{r}
                                  "heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature",

  # denoise signatures as well

  for (y_var in c(noise.signature.use, celltype.signature.use, "heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature")) {

      plot_data[[y_var]] <- residuals(model)
    }
    
    # scale

  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  plot_data <- plot_data[sample(1:nrow(plot_data)), ]
  
  if (denoise) {
    plot_title <- "After denoising"
  } else {
    plot_title <- "Before denoising"
  }
  
  if (celltype.use == "Malignant cluster") {

  # ----- BIOLOGY -----

  # ----- NOISE -----

  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
library(cluster)

patient.id.use <- "C34809"
x.lim <- c(-50, 25)

centroid.distances.list <- list()

for (denoise in c(FALSE, TRUE)) {
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "results/", 'denoising_metrics/', 'sussman_2024/', 'by_sample/', 'seurat_objs/', 'seurat.obj_denoise=FALSE.RDS'))

  # }
  

  #seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (patient_id == patient.id.use))
  
  set.seed(123)
  seurat.obj.subset <- seurat.obj
  seurat.obj.subset$downsample <- T
  Idents(seurat.obj.subset) <- "sample.id"
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = downsample == TRUE, downsample = 100)
  
  seurat.obj.subset <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset)
  vf <- VariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset)
  
  seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, gene.signatures)
  
  if (denoise) {
    seurat.obj.subset <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.subset, vars.to.regress = c("postmortem.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "heat.shock.signature"))
  } else {
    seurat.obj.subset <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.subset)
  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  seurat.obj.subset <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.subset, features = VariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset), approx = TRUE, seed.use = 42)
  
  seurat.obj.subset$annotation <- seurat.obj.subset$predicted.annotation_l1.w.qc
  # seurat.obj.subset@meta.data <- seurat.obj.subset@meta.data %>% dplyr::mutate(annotation = case_when(
  #    predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc == "Excitatory neurons" ~ "Excitatory neurons",
  #    predicted.annotation_l2.w.qc == "Inhibitory neurons" ~ "Inhibitory neurons",
  #    TRUE ~ predicted.annotation_l1.w.qc
  # ))
  #    
     
  # seurat.obj.subset@meta.data <- seurat.obj.subset@meta.data %>% dplyr::mutate(annotation = case_when(
  #   predicted.annotation_l1.w.qc == "Malignant cluster" & timepoint == "Initial CNS Tumor" ~ "Malignant primary surgical",
  #   predicted.annotation_l1.w.qc == "Malignant cluster" & timepoint == "Recurrence/Progressive (Non-Autopsy)" ~ "Malignant recurrent surgical",
  #   predicted.annotation_l1.w.qc == "Malignant cluster" & timepoint == "Progressive (Autopsy)" ~ "Malignant progressive postmortem",
  #   TRUE ~ predicted.annotation_l1.w.qc
  # ))
  # 
  # 
  # # Named color palette for cell types
  # cell_type_colors <- c(
  #   "Glial"                          = "#E69F00", # Warm Orange
  #   "Immune"                         = "#56B4E9", # Sky Blue
  #   "Malignant primary surgical"     = "#009E73", # Original Vibrant Green
  #   "Malignant recurrent surgical"   = "#007A58", # Medium Dark Green
  #   "Malignant progressive postmortem" = "#00523A", # Deep Forest Green
  #   "Neurons"                        = "#F0E442", # Yellow
  #   "Vascular"                       = "#0072B2", # Blue
  #   "Low quality"                    = "#888888", # Gray
  #   "Filtered out"                   = "#888888"  # Gray
  # )
  # 
  annotation.l2.w.qc.labels <- get.count.labels(seurat.obj.subset$annotation, cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.colors)
  
  pca.df <- Embeddings(seurat.obj.subset, "pca")[, 1:4] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    cbind(
      annotation = seurat.obj.subset$annotation,
      timepoint = seurat.obj.subset$timepoint
    )
  
  set.seed(123)
  pca.df <- pca.df[sample(nrow(pca.df)), ]
  
  # pca_scores: matrix of PC coordinates (rows = cells, cols = PCs used)
  # cell_type: factor/vector of known labels
  dist_matrix <- dist(pca.df %>% dplyr::select(PC_1, PC_2))
  sil <- silhouette(as.integer(as.factor(pca.df %>% pull(annotation))), dist_matrix)
  mean(sil[, "sil_width"])  # overall score
  summary(sil)              # per-cluster breakdown


  
  centroids <- pca.df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(annotation) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      PC_1 = mean(PC_1),
      PC_2 = mean(PC_2),
      PC_3 = mean(PC_3),
      PC_4 = mean(PC_4)
    ) %>%
    data.frame()
  
  #centroids <- centroids %>% filter(annotation != "Low quality")
  
  # ── Compute all pairwise Euclidean distances between centroids ───────────────
  centroid.distances <- dist(centroids %>% column_to_rownames("annotation") %>% dplyr::select(PC_1, PC_2),
         method = "euclidean") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("cell_type_1") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-cell_type_1, names_to = "cell_type_2", values_to = "distance") %>%
    filter(cell_type_1 < cell_type_2) %>%
    mutate(denoise = denoise)
  
  centroid.distances.list[[as.character(denoise)]] <- centroid.distances
  # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  if (denoise) {
    title <- "After denoising"
  } else {
    title <- "Before denoising"
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(pca.df, aes(PC_1, PC_2)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = annotation),
      size = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(color = annotation),
      level = 0.68,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = centroids,
      aes(PC_1, PC_2, color = annotation),
      size = 3,
      shape = 18
    ) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    labs(color = "Cell type") +
    annotation.l2.w.qc.labels #+ xlim(x.lim) + ylim(y.lim)
  
   pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, patient.id.use, '_PCA12_by_cell_type_denoise=', denoise, '.pdf'), width = 12, height = 8)
   print(p)
   dev.off()
  
   
  p <- ggplot(pca.df, aes(PC_2, PC_3)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = annotation),
      size = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(color = annotation),
      level = 0.68,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = centroids,
      aes(PC_2, PC_3, color = annotation),
      size = 3,
      shape = 18
    ) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    labs(color = "Cell type") +
    annotation.l2.w.qc.labels
  
  pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, patient.id.use, '_PCA23_by_cell_type_denoise=', denoise, '.pdf'), width = 12, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```

# Figure 2: C34809 PCA before and after denoising, all cells
```{r}
patient.id.use <- "C34809"
x.lim <- c(-15, 65)   
y.lim <- c(-35, 8)    

centroid.distances.list <- list()

for (denoise in c(FALSE, TRUE)) {
  # 
  # if (denoise) {
  #   seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "results/", 'denoising_metrics/', 'sussman_2024/', 'by_sample/', 'seurat_objs/', 'seurat.obj_denoise=heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature.RDS'))
  # } else {
  #   seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "results/", 'denoising_metrics/', 'sussman_2024/', 'by_sample/', 'seurat_objs/', 'seurat.obj_denoise=FALSE.RDS'))
  # }
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "results/", 'denoising_metrics/', 'sussman_2024/', 'by_sample/', 'seurat_objs/', 'seurat.obj_denoise=FALSE.RDS'))
  seurat.obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj)
  
  if (denoise) {
    seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures[c("postmortem.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "heat.shock.signature")])
     seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj, vars.to.regress = c("postmortem.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "heat.shock.signature"))
  } else {
    seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj)
  }
  
  Idents(seurat.obj) <- "patient_id"
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (patient_id == patient.id.use))
  
  set.seed(123)
  seurat.obj.subset <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.subset, features = VariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset), approx = TRUE, seed.use = 42)
  
  annotation.l2.w.qc.labels <- get.count.labels(seurat.obj.subset$annotation.l2.w.qc, cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.colors.2)
  
  pca.df <- Embeddings(seurat.obj.subset, "pca")[, 1:2] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    cbind(
      annotation = seurat.obj.subset$annotation.l2.w.qc
    )
  if (denoise) {
    pca.df$PC_1 <- -pca.df$PC_1
  }
  
  set.seed(123) 
  # malignant on the bottom and shuffle the rest
  malignant <- pca.df[pca.df$annotation == "Malignant cluster", ]
  other     <- pca.df[pca.df$annotation != "Malignant cluster", ]
  other <- other[sample(nrow(other)), ]
  pca.df <- rbind(malignant, other)
  
  centroids <- pca.df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(annotation) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      PC_1 = mean(PC_1),
      PC_2 = mean(PC_2)
    ) %>%
    data.frame()
  
  # ── Compute all pairwise Euclidean distances between centroids ───────────────
  centroid.distances <- dist(centroids %>% column_to_rownames("annotation") %>% dplyr::select(PC_1, PC_2),
         method = "euclidean") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("cell_type_1") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-cell_type_1, names_to = "cell_type_2", values_to = "distance") %>%
    filter(cell_type_1 < cell_type_2) %>%
    mutate(denoise = denoise)
  
  centroid.distances.list[[as.character(denoise)]] <- centroid.distances
  # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  if (denoise) {
    title <- "After denoising"
  } else {
    title <- "Before denoising"
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(pca.df, aes(PC_1, PC_2)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = annotation),
      size = 1,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(color = annotation),
      level = 0.68,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = centroids,
      aes(PC_1, PC_2, color = annotation),
      size = 3,
      shape = 18
    ) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    labs(color = "Cell type") +
    annotation.l2.w.qc.labels +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x.lim, ylim = y.lim)
  
  pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, patient.id.use, '_PCA_by_cell_type_denoise=', denoise, '.pdf'), width = 12, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```
